customManagers.description: Images and tool versions handed to a job or composite action through an input DEFAULT, under a `# renovate:` line. Renovate's workflow manager pins `uses:` refs but is blind to these, so nothing would watch the toolchain a release actually runs in. Same annotated-default pattern infrastructure uses for tool versions passed to composite actions. Two shapes, in single or double quotes: an image (`name:tag`, with `@sha256:` when the default pins a digest, so a bump rewrites both; the repository comes from depName) and a bare version (`v2.6.5`, `5.0.3`). Until 2026-11-01 only the single-quoted image shape matched, and cosign v2.4.3, syft v1.48.0, dnscontrol 5.0.3 and the buildkit, buildkit-syft-scanner and binfmt digests froze unseen.

packageRules.description: Renovate never adds a digest to an annotated default that has none. The semantic-release toolchain default carries its digest explicitly, and Renovate keeps an existing digest current on every bump.
dnscontrol's default is the bare version: the workflow adds the `v` to the release URL itself, so the release tag's `v` is stripped.

cosign 3 refuses `--tlog-upload=false` under its default signing config and signs a Sigstore bundle by default, which homelab-cluster's ClusterPolicy verifyImages cannot read (tested 2026-11-01 with cosign 3.1.4 and Kyverno 1.19.2). The major waits on the dashboard and lands as a migration: homelab's image-verify policies move to ImageValidatingPolicy first, then cosign-sign-attest signs with a signing config that has no transparency log.
prBodyNotes: Do not merge as a plain bump. `cosign sign --tlog-upload=false` fails on cosign 3; sign with `--signing-config` from `cosign signing-config create`, and move homelab-cluster's image-verify ClusterPolicies to ImageValidatingPolicy first (unfold-cluster PR #179 tests both formats).

packageRules.description: The release toolchain image is first-party (built and released by webgrip/semantic-release-config, tagged with the config version it carries, ADR 0005) and every estate release runs in it, so a new patch or minor toolchain must reach this repo's defaults without a dashboard tick: on 2026-10-24 semantic-release 0.3.7 and semantic-release-monorepo 0.3.6, the first images with @webgrip/semantic-release-config 1.4.0 (homelab ADR-0069's forge adapter), waited behind the org preset's dependencyDashboardApproval. A major is a new config major that changes what every caller's release does, so it stays behind the preset's dashboard approval and is never merged unattended. The semantic-release-monorepo image is retired: config 2.x builds monorepo trains itself. The semantic-release-rust image is retired: nothing used it (VIK-2321).
